name: Globex open ORB 15 failed break → fade, flat 20:00
why: Stops cluster just beyond the opening range; aggressors who push through and cannot hold (the 5-minute bar closes back inside) are trapped, and their exits drive price back across the range. Pre-registered 2026-10-18 (research/preregistered/2026-10-18_session_cockpit.md).
